events.title: Battle of Ascalon
events.description: Crusader forces under Godfrey of Bouillon defeated a Fatimid army led by the vizier al-Afdal Shahanshah near Ascalon, shortly after the capture of Jerusalem.
events.significance: The victory secured the Crusaders' hold on Jerusalem and the newly founded Kingdom of Jerusalem, though Ascalon itself remained in Fatimid hands for decades.

events.title: Isaac Singer Patents His Sewing Machine
events.description: Isaac Merritt Singer received a US patent for his improved sewing machine, which featured a vertically moving presser foot and a motorized-friendly design.
events.significance: Singer's design and his innovative marketing and installment-payment plans helped bring sewing machines into homes and factories worldwide, transforming the garment industry.

events.title: Joseph Lister Performs First Antiseptic Surgery
events.description: British surgeon Joseph Lister used carbolic acid to disinfect a wound and surgical dressings while treating a compound fracture in a young patient at Glasgow Royal Infirmary.
events.significance: This marked the beginning of antiseptic surgery, dramatically reducing post-operative infections and laying the groundwork for modern sterile surgical practice.

events.title: Hawaii Formally Annexed by the United States
events.description: In a ceremony at Iolani Palace in Honolulu, the Hawaiian flag was lowered and the American flag raised, formalizing the transfer of sovereignty following the Newlands Resolution.
events.significance: The annexation extended US territory into the Pacific, strengthened American strategic presence in the region, and led to Hawaii becoming a state in 1959.

events.title: IBM Introduces the IBM Personal Computer
events.description: IBM unveiled the IBM PC (Model 5150) at a press event in New York City, featuring an Intel 8088 processor and Microsoft's PC-DOS operating system.
events.significance: Its open architecture established the standard for personal computers, fueled the growth of the software and clone industries, and accelerated the spread of computing in business and homes.
